title: Tracked changes ods 001
notes: real ODF spreadsheet revisions: the same text:changed-region machinery as the odt counterpart (ODF 1.2 §2.4) but inside table:table-cell content — text:delete ct2 (dc:creator bot-a, fixed dc:date 2026-01-01T00:00:00) sits inline between the runs of the first cell's text:p, and text:insert ct1 wraps the whole inserted text:p of the second cell; both cells' office:string-value carry the ACCEPTED view. Reference text states the ACCEPTED view: inserted paragraph text included, deleted fragment excluded (same convention as the docx/odt tracked-changes fixtures). Honest caveats: whether LibreOffice shows or hides the revision marks is a per-view show-changes setting, and LO's per-cell change bookkeeping beyond the region elements is not emitted — neither verified (LibreOffice is not run in this environment). changed-region/insert/delete match no normative counter except table:table=1.
